title: NBI: Pet ‘ashes’ appear to be ‘sand’ or ‘cement’
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The urns submitted by pet owners, who feared they fell victim to a pet crematorium scam, appeared to be filled with “sand” or “cement,” the National Bureau of Investigation…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The urns submitted by pet owners, who feared they fell victim to a pet crematorium scam, appeared to be filled with “sand” or “cement,” the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) said. This revelation from the NBI came after its previous statement that it discovered no traces of animal remains in the urns
